cx2_truthful.basis: The custodian saw Mara enter alone carrying a wet umbrella, which the documented sensor defect explains could trigger a double count. Elevator counts and records-door logs support her account of a solitary records-floor visit lasting about fifteen minutes. Collecting personal items after hours was permitted. The records close the main gaps without establishing concealed involvement.

cx2_deceptive.basis: Mara acknowledges Evan’s entry and departure but avoids describing their movements in A3. The custodian’s observation, two-person elevator trips and Mara’s exclusive records-door events together establish their visit to the records floor—the involvement she omits. Entry on her single swipe violated policy, and no after-hours visitor was registered.

cx3.basis: The alert shows a double count, but rec-05 documents sensor false positives. No examined record establishes that Evan or anyone else entered with Mara. A3 omits Evan’s whereabouts and A4 omits how she left, leaving key gaps unresolved. These omissions alone cannot establish concealment.
